about.title: About me
about.intro: As a certified Fullstack Web Developer, I develop web applications using JavaScript, TypeScript and Angular in the frontend, as well as Python, Django and Django REST Framework in the backend. My enthusiasm for software development began at the age of 18 with personal projects, including database-driven applications built with Turbo Pascal and dBASE, and has stayed with me ever since.
about.location: I live near Braunschweig and am open to different working models – from working on-site and hybrid arrangements to remote work. What matters to me is a productive working environment and good communication within the team.
about.learning: I see my current tech stack as a foundation that I want to continuously build on by learning additional programming languages, frameworks and technologies. I use AI purposefully for planning, analysis, development and debugging.
about.problemSolving: When tackling technical tasks, I work analytically and systematically – an approach I have regularly applied in my self-employed work. I break complex tasks into manageable steps, work with a clear plan and look for practical solutions that are as simple as possible. Persistence, creativity and my many years of experience in business, communication, team leadership and collaboration help me along the way.

skills.title: My skills
skills.intro: My tech stack covers frontend, backend, databases, testing and deployment.
skills.description: I enjoy learning new technologies and frameworks and expanding my stack as needed – for example with React.

projects.title: Portfolio
projects.intro: Explore a selection of my projects and see how I apply my skills in practice.

coderr.description: Backend for a freelancer developer platform connecting customers with business users and their service offers. The application provides APIs for authentication, user profiles, offers, orders and reviews and integrates with a separately developed frontend.

kanmind.description: Backend for a project management application with boards, tasks and comments. The project focuses on structured REST APIs, authentication, object-level permissions and the integration of an existing frontend with a Django backend.

join.description: Kanban task management application developed as part of a Scrum team. We coordinated our work using a shared KanMind board and collaborated through GitHub for development and version control.

pokedex.description: Pokédex web application built with API integration. The project focuses on working with external data sources, dynamic rendering and interactive user interface behavior.

bestellApp.description: Ordering app for practicing shopping cart functionality and more advanced business logic in JavaScript. The project helped deepen my understanding of state handling and interactive frontend behavior.
